_meta.definition: Activities related to managing and registering various media assets such as movies, aliases, cast types, companies, keywords, and links.

aka_title._description: Captures movie aliases and variations, including title details, IMDb index, production year, and episode information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for alternate titles of movies.

columns.name: movie_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the movie_ entity

columns.name: title
columns.description: Stores movie/TV show titles in various languages.
samples: Malhação - Adolescência: A Passagem da Infância Para a Vida Adulta

columns.name: imdb_index
columns.description: Stores sequential identifiers for alternate film titles (e.g., I, II, III, V, XI).

columns.name: kind_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the kind_ entity

columns.name: production_year
columns.description: Stores the production year for alternate titles.

columns.name: phonetic_code
columns.description: Stores phonetic codes for alternate film titles.

columns.name: episode_of_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the episode_of_ entity

columns.name: season_nr
columns.description: Stores the number of television series seasons associated with a title.

columns.name: episode_nr
columns.description: Stores episode numbers for alternate titles of media content.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Stores alternative titles or translations for films in various languages.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores unique 128-bit hash digests of title alternative names.

comp_cast_type._description: Records movie cast member roles and their types (e.g., actor, director, producer).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for different types of cast members (e.g., lead, supporting, guest) in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Stores type of IMDB entity (cast or crew) and status (complete or complete+verified).

company_type._description: Records various types of companies in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for different types of companies (1, 2, 3, 4).

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Stores types of companies involved in film production, such as distributors, production, special effects, and miscellaneous.

keyword._description: Stores unique keywords and their phonetic codes for efficient search and recommendation of movie titles and actors.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for movie keywords (e.g., genres, themes) within the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: keyword
columns.description: Stores descriptive phrases or terms associated with movies or TV shows.

columns.name: phonetic_code
columns.description: Stores phonetic representations (H5321, J5235, etc.) of movie keywords for search and matching purposes.

kind_type._description: Records movie genre types and their respective identifiers.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for different types of movie genres.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Stores type of media content: movie, TV series, TV movie, video movie, TV mini series.

link_type._description: Records various types of relationships between entities in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for different types of relationships between entities in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: link
columns.description: Stores relationship types between movies (e.g., follows, remake of, references).

title._description: Captures information about individual movies and TV episodes, including their metadata, IMDb index, production year, and series details.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for movie titles.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Stores movie/TV show titles, along with some containing numbers or dates.

columns.name: imdb_index
columns.description: Stores unique IMDb identifiers for movie titles, represented as Roman numerals or codes by Danny Pardo.

columns.name: kind_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the kind_ entity

columns.name: production_year
columns.description: Stores the year a movie was produced.

columns.name: imdb_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the imdb_ entity

columns.name: phonetic_code
columns.description: Stores phonetic representations (J2326, A5162, etc.) for movie titles.

columns.name: episode_of_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the episode_of_ entity

columns.name: season_nr
columns.description: Stores numeric representation of television series seasons.

columns.name: episode_nr
columns.description: Stores the episode number within a TV series title.

columns.name: series_years
columns.description: Stores multiple years (separated by hyphens) for TV series episodes or seasons.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores unique 128-bit hash digests of movie titles.
